title: SHANG++: Robust Stochastic Acceleration under Multiplicative Noise
abstract: arXiv:2603.09355v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Under the multiplicative noise scaling (MNS) condition, original Nesterov acceleration is provably sensitive to noise and may diverge when gradient noise overwhelms the signal. In this paper, we develop two accelerated stochastic gradient descent methods by discretizing the Hessian-driven Nesterov accelerated gradient flow. We first derive SHANG, a direct semi-implicit discretization that already improves stability under MNS. We then introduce SHANG++, which adds a damping correction and achieves faster convergence with greater noise robustness. We establish convergence guarantees for both convex and strongly convex objectives under MNS, together with explicit parameter choices. In our experiments, SHANG++ performs consistently well across convex problems and applications in deep learning. translated_title: SHANG++：乘法噪声下的鲁棒随机加速方法
translated_abstract: 在乘法噪声缩放（MNS）条件下，原始的Nesterov加速方法被证明对噪声敏感，当梯度噪声超过信号时可能发散。本文通过离散化Hessian驱动的Nesterov加速梯度流，开发了两种加速随机梯度下降方法。我们首先推导出SHANG，一种直接半隐式离散化方法，已在MNS下提高了稳定性。随后我们引入SHANG++，它添加了阻尼校正，实现了更快的收敛和更强的噪声鲁棒性。我们在MNS下为凸和强凸目标建立了收敛保证，并给出了明确的参数选择。在我们的实验中，SHANG++在凸问题和深度学习应用中表现一致良好。在ResNet-34的专门噪声实验中，单一超参数配置将准确率保持在无噪声结果的一个百分点以内。
tldr: 本文提出SHANG++，一种通过阻尼校正改进的半隐式离散化随机加速方法，在乘法噪声下实现更快收敛和更强鲁棒性，并在深度学习中保持稳定性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SHANG++, a damping-corrected semi-implicit discretization method that achieves faster convergence and greater robustness under multiplicative noise, maintaining stable performance in deep learning applications.
